signal: 365 Retail Markets completed its $848M acquisition of Cantaloupe, expanding its self-service commerce footprint across North America, Latin America, and Europe

email.body1:
Lorenc, saw 365 Retail Markets closed the $848M Cantaloupe acquisition and is expanding across new regions.

Integrations that size usually create more in-market accounts than the combined team can cover, and the gap is where signals cool before anyone acts. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, sequenced outreach autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for 365 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lorenc, quick follow-up.

Post-merger, two motions and two data sets usually mean the lift hides in latency and hygiene, not effort. Reps burn hours on research, writing, and CRM, so the accounts that matter get touched late, and the lift never shows in the numbers.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of 365's current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Lorenc, last bit of proof for 365.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how 365's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lorenc, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't on the roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. Folding in an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to 365 either way.
